data.interpretation: Family γ canonical decomposition verified: Q_A and cos at q₀ are FINITE (no pole here), so the structural singularity at u = u_substrate from PR #1727 lives in the Π_k(∞) tower as k → ∞. The asymptotic c_{k+1}/c_k → 1/u_substrate (PR #1713) confirms simple-pole behavior at the edge of convergence. The residue A categorical-ID is the open work; Family α (Habiro-Wenzl projector traces) and Family β (Habiro-Kashaev quantum-dilog tower) are the natural next routes.
